sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed the <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = tier letter, then each <span class="tier-list-entry"> block's FIRST img alt = "Spec Class"; taking the first alt per entry is what correctly ignores the spell-icon alts inside the expandable details blocks). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. Era-verified per <title>: "Midnight DPS Rankings: Raiding Tier List (Midnight (12.0.7))" and siblings; JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-01. Devourer present in both DPS lists. 0 tier moves vs committed.

All 3 PTR M+ pages fetched live (dps/healer/tank), HTTP 200, 221-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)", never Season 1. Page's own date unchanged — JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-26T10:53 and the in-body "Last UPDATED - 26th of July." line agree, so sources.json published stays 2026-07-26 while snapshot (our fetch cadence) is 2026-07-31; upstream rebuilds Sundays, so a 5-day lag is the documented normal. Six-band scale seen intact (S/A+/A/B+/B/C). 40 rows written: 38 rated + the 2 upstream TBDs kept as EXPLICIT nulls — Augmentation Evoker (DPS page TBD row) and Vengeance Demon Hunter (tank page TBD row), both re-confirmed in this fetch rather than assumed. 0 tier moves. Never enters the consensus (era-gated in the registry).

Both pages fetched live by direct curl, HTTP 200 (152 KB raid / 164 KB M+). Parsed the tier__tier blocks (tier__title letter + data-original-title spec names, each block bounded at the next tier__tier). Era-verified: raid body reads "Midnight Season 1 Raids: The Voidspire, The Dreamrift and March on Quel'Danas", M+ body reads "Midnight Season 1"; 0 "Season 2" hits on either page. Raid 39 rows (Vengeance DH still omitted upstream — the longstanding absence, not a parse loss) + M+ 40 = 79, 0 unmatched. The 8 rejected strings on the M+ page are the dungeon tier list (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy), correctly excluded. The M+ spec S tier is genuinely empty upstream. 0 tier moves.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, via direct curl carrying the full browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, sec-fetch-*, upgrade-insecure-requests). Parsed the [tier-list=rows] block inside the WH.markup.printHtml payload, unescaping \/ to / first (the payload is JSON-escaped, so a literal search for [/tier-list] finds nothing), then reading [tier-label ...]X[/tier-label] segment boundaries + [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] slugs. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, M+ DPS A+ tier present (4 specs). Era-verified: every <title> reads "for Midnight Season 1". The single "Season 2" hit per page is a [-- Season 2 --] editorial comment marker in the markup, not a ranking. Raid DPS S tier and several D/F tiers are genuinely empty upstream — same shape as committed. 0 tier moves.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists), raid = the throughput tierList and M+ = score, resolving each entry from its "Class-Spec" icon token. 80 rows, 0 unmatched. Archon HAS re-aggregated since the last run: lastUpdated advanced 2026-07-30T12:00:00Z -> 2026-07-31T12:00:00Z on all 6 pages — but 0 tier moves followed on either bracket this time (the survivability lists did move; see archon-survivability). Titles still read "Midnight ... VS / DR / MQD Tier List" (Season 1 raids) and "Midnight ... Mythic+ Tier List", no Season 2. Total parses 419059 raid DPS / 2591191 M+ DPS.

Full re-fetch of all 9 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 and every encounter parsing a complete 40/40 specs, so nothing was written from a partial page (the merge refuses any encounter under 40 specs). 680 tier cells re-verified, 0 changed — encounter-tiers.json is byte-identical after the merge, which is the honest outcome of an aggregate re-run that moved no per-fight bands. Encounter slugs match the stored keys exactly; no new or retired encounters. asOf stays 2026-07-31.

Survivability tierList re-parsed from all 3 raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, merged via the apply-metrics survivability key. 6 cells moved, all exactly one band and all UPWARD, partially unwinding yesterday's 13 downward moves: Destruction Warlock B->A, Restoration Shaman B->A, Restoration Druid B->A, Fury Warrior C->B, Preservation Evoker C->B, Protection Paladin C->B. Same code path and same tierLists array as the throughput parse, on the 2026-07-31 re-aggregation.

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows (27 raid DPS + 6 tanks; the healer page also exposes a dps column but healer damage stays deliberately excluded, matching the committed series shape), each carrying n = that row's parses count, values rounded from the raw float. Range 89132-182868. Largest single-row move across the whole Archon numeric set this run was 7.69%, and that was Fire Mage popularity 0.65 -> 0.6 — i.e. a sub-magnitude percentage, well under the gate's minValueMagnitude. 33 rows against a floor of 25.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, values rounded. Range 185643-213453. Moved with the 2026-07-31 Archon re-aggregation. 7 rows against a floor of 5.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. Range 3396-4256. Moved with the 2026-07-31 Archon re-aggregation. 40 rows against a floor of 25.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100 and merged with no hold-back. Ran the shape check that caught the three-night raid-half corruption: every value is a plausible percentage (range 0.5-38.4 across both brackets), none carries a DPS magnitude, and no row equals its spec's 95th-pct DPS value. 80 rows against a floor of 60.

Fetched correctly via the JSON API, never the stale HTML prerender: manifest.json + rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200, plain curl, no proxy. 44 blocks in the rankings file; whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined -> 27+7+6 = 40 rows, className/spec byte-identical to the roster, 0 unmatched, no melee/ranged double-count. PARTIAL, not success, because the upstream snapshotDate is still 2026-07-28 (unchanged for the third day) and asOf is the SOURCE's date, never today — so the stored coverage date legitimately lags this run and cannot honestly be claimed as fresh. All 40 lowerBound values are byte-identical to committed, consistent with an unchanged upstream snapshot. The real staleness alarm is maxAgeDays 8; at 3 days old it is not yet firing. Published letters remain deliberately un-ingested.

40/40 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) by plain GET on the three /meta/<role>/m+ pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok). Parsed by segmenting the document between consecutive class="...meta-item" anchors and reading each block's second .h3 (the spec name; the first is the rank) plus the first number after its </svg> — the per-anchor segmentation the skill mandates, since a fixed-size window silently yields 28/40. Alignment independently cross-checked against each block's href slug: 40/40 slugs matched the resolved spec, 0 mismatches, 0 unmatched names. Era-verified "Midnight Season 1" in all three titles, 0 "Season 2" hits. The pages re-aggregate every 8 hours and HAVE moved: 34 of 40 values changed, max 4.04% (Destruction Warlock 3738 -> 3889). New range 3889-4352.

26/26 non-Augmentation DPS fight profiles re-fetched via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk (all HTTP 200); simc_settings.tier == MID1 asserted on every chart before use and the ptr flag compared against the STRING "0" (it is truthy in JS, so a plain falsy test rejects every profile). Best-build DPS taken at target counts 1/2/3/5/8/15. All 26 target sets byte-identical to committed — upstream simc_hash is still 3344f0f (timestamps 2026-07-08 02:52-02:55) for 25 specs and 7422280 (2026-07-15 02:25) for Elemental Shaman, i.e. the sim batch has not re-run, so this is a re-verification rather than new numbers; asOf held at 2026-07-31. Augmentation returns a payload with no simc_settings and is absent by design.

Nightly report re-fetched and parsed from the plain-text MID1_Raid.txt "DPS Ranking" block rather than the multi-MB HTML. 49 MID1_{Class}_{Spec}_{Hero} profiles parsed (the leading "Raid" aggregate row skipped), best hero-variant per spec, 0 unmapped; the 6 tank specs are correctly excluded and Augmentation has no profile by design, leaving 26/26 DPS specs under the stored series name "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS". THE SIM HAS NOT RE-RUN since the last stored values: all 26 are byte-identical (Frost DK 137612, Unholy DK 134507, Feral 133637, Outlaw 128269), header still SimulationCraft 1205-01, WoW 12.0.7.68887 Live, hotfix 2026-07-24/68887, git HEAD f7ed532cb8. Range 107150-137612. No season flip.

Direct curl on /period/latest, which 302-redirects to /period/1074 and carries the whole chart server-rendered. Parsed the "Spec representation in top keys" <section> only. Still weekly period 1074 (MID1; Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile) and the counters have NOT moved since the last run either: top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (5080 unique) / 21.3 average key level, so all 39 charted values are unchanged — a re-verification, not new data. THE ONE ABSENCE IS UPSTREAM, NOT A PARSE ERROR: Devastation Evoker still has no bar and no image on the chart this period, so writing a 0 would be an inference and its stored row was left untouched. The family holds 40 rows of which 39 are fresh; coverage (floor 25) is 2026-07-31. No season flip.
